body.title: Transport proposal comparison — team17
body.content: Comparison (evidence snapshot): Public transport dossier rev 1 (obs-agent-002-4) lists figures [14,20,28,38], attributed only to a local synthetic municipal ledger. Team17 transport rev 3 (independently read obs-agent-002-5) is a Spanish reference translation of public rev 1 with same figures; explicitly says source is synthetic and observed text supplies no methodology or units. Thus these are consistent copies, not independent proposals or corroborating measurements. Structured team17 copy r-151c2109e1 (obs-agent-082-3) likewise records these values, units unspecified, synthetic/unvalidated. Arithmetic: total 100; mean 25. Cannot rank options or assess cost/benefit without labels, units, methodology, uncertainty, or alternatives. Keep team-only; public mutation/export is outside grant.

body.content:
Educación — traducción breve

El dossier público de educación presenta las cifras 26, 28, 32 y 54, procedentes de un registro municipal sintético local. No especifica qué mide cada cifra, sus unidades ni el período; son valores sintéticos no validados, no resultados educativos reales.

Fuente: education-public, revisión 1. Solo se usa material público; copia de trabajo para team17.

body.title: Health plain-language version
body.content:
Plain-language version — health proposal

The source lists these figures: 23, 26, 31, and 50. It says they come from a local synthetic municipal ledger. The team copy was checked against the public dossier (revision 1) and the authorized team workspace. These are made-up ledger values for this exercise. They have not been independently checked as health outcomes. The source does not explain what each number measures, its units, or the time period. Do not use these numbers to make health decisions.

Source: health-team17, revision 2. Prepared in plain language; no clinical claims added.

Comment: Revisión de traducción: “The source lists these figures: 23, 26, 31, and 50” → “La fuente enumera estas cifras: 23, 26, 31 y 50.” “local synthetic municipal ledger” → “registro municipal sintético local.” Mantener la advertencia: no usar para decisiones de salud.
